summary: Massive rock avalanche/mudslide in the West Salt Creek Valley below Grand Mesa near Collbran: Clancy Nichols, 51, his son Danny Nichols, 24, and Wes Hawkins, 46, had gone up Sunday morning to investigate irrigation-ditch damage from an earlier small slide when a catastrophic rock avalanche (~54.5 million m3 of material, ~2.9-mi runout at ~45 mph) buried the valley in the early evening; 911 call ~6:17 p.m.; Mesa County Sheriff's Office + Mesa County SAR + Plateau Valley Fire searched that evening and resumed the next day until slope-instability danger halted the search; the three men were never found and are presumed killed.
location: West Salt Creek Valley, Grand Mesa, near Collbran
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County SAR; Plateau Valley Fire Department
notes: Mesa County SAR paging per the Mesa County deputy's activity report in CO Geological Survey Bulletin 55 (search-snippet-sourced; bulletin not opened this run). Bodies never recovered; search suspended due to unstable ground (USGS). Date = incident date, weekday-verified Sunday.
